# Smart-source exclusion still lets a new saved search register its own listeners

At fixed revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, legacy nsMsgAccountManager::OnFolderAdded expects Panorama disabled via MOZ_ASSERT and requires a parent. It excludes Virtual folders from smart-folder source classification and parent-source scope updates. A separate tail still handles Virtual folders when m_loadingVirtualFolders is false: after successful DB lookup, it reads searchFolderUri, calls AddVFListenersForVF and SaveVirtualFolders. Excluding a saved search as another search’s source does not skip that saved search’s own listener/persistence setup. This is bounded source inspection, not a full listener lifecycle, persistence-success or runtime guarantee.

Scope: Legacy smart-folder source and listener setup.
